title: Connector link authentication and key rotation
description: The signed challenge that authenticates a machine on every connection, and key rotation (C-05.4 to C-05.9). TLS, terminated by Caddy at the hub, authenticates the hub; these frames prove the machine's Ed25519 key. Nothing web-chat emits today: the portal admits a viewer with a Cloudflare Access JWT (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/portal/access-jwt.js) and has no machine credential.

auth_challenge.description: The hub's first frame after the upgrade (C-05.5). Direction: hub to connector.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, base64url, single use, bound to this socket.

expires_at.description: The nonce dies 10 s after issue; no auth.response by then closes the link with 4401.

auth_response.description: The connector proves its key (C-05.5). Direction: connector to hub.

machine_id.description: The machine's hub id (contract 03: `mch_` and 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters).

key_id.description: The key's id (contract 03 section 2, prefix `mky`): `mky_` and the first 26 characters of the Crockford base32 of SHA-256 over the raw public key, computed the same way by both sides. Names a key without carrying it.

public_key.description: An Ed25519 public key: the raw 32 bytes, base64url without padding (contract 03 `machine.public_key.value`).

auth_ok.description: The key is one the machine record accepts; hello must follow (C-05.5, C-05.7). Direction: hub to connector.

connection.description: The connector session (contract 03 `connector_session`): one authenticated link.

expires_at.description: When this connector session ends (contract 03: at most 24 h). The hub closes with 4440 then and the connector dials again at once.

key_id.description: The machine's current key (contract 03 section 2, prefix `mky`). Differs from the key the connector signed with only while a rotation is being completed (C-05.7).

rotate.description: True when the hub wants a new key on this connection (C-05.7).

auth_refused.description: Authentication failed; the hub closes with the code C-05.9 names next. Direction: hub to connector.
